cohort$trt = factor(cohort$trt, levels = c(1, 2))
cohort$event = cohort$status == 1
qc = data.frame(n_input = nrow(raw), n = nrow(cohort), events = sum(cohort$event))
utils::write.csv(qc, file = "qc.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print(qc)
print(table(cohort$trt, useNA = "ifany"))
print(normalizePath("qc.csv"))
